For improvements. I’ve been a J.AI Ultra subscriber for quite some time and really enjoy the service, but the way the app handles user prompts needs improvement. Often, when I send a prompt to continue a story, the app fails to keep up with the narrative, instead, it sends messages like "I am an AI designed for [X] and, unfortunately, cannot continue this conversation due to [X]" or simply generates a completely incoherent response. I frequently have to delete and resend the message multiple times to get it to work, or switch models often due to an error stating the model is unavailable, even though it works perfectly once I restart the process. I would really like to see improvements in this area, as I genuinely like the app especially since it’s one of the few that doesn't have content filters and supports long messages. I also think the message limits for non-subscribers should be changed, the current system seems a bit unfair.

I've heard that this app is a "better" alt to C.AI…. But immediately, it asked for money, and then, constant advertising, and no other features, than just to type to a character… without money.

I’ve heard that this app uses a more advanced model (than what C.AI uses), and that it’s less restrictive, too… 

But it's also less flexible for me to edit a comment, so that the character can continue the same edits… (like Spivak pronouns: e, eir, and em = E for Everyone, one of my fond edits that I like using for C.AI characters, to give me peace of mind).

And also like on C.AI, I can even ask it to mute certain words, in the settings…

So essentially, more customization for free users (on C.AI).

So, there’s a contrast between the two, due to due to what I’ve gotten from:
J.AI = less restrictive, but money pressure.
C.AI = incredibly restrictive, but essentially for free.

i’m not sure what it’s "behind the scenes“, though. But this is my reaction.

Some suggestions. Honestly this app has a lot of potential and it’s kind of upsetting that the developers don’t seem to be listening to the reviews in the comments. To start, when I downloaded this app there was nothing advertised saying you got a limited amount of chats per day. I sent FOUR chats before it told me my limit was up for today. Only four chats is crazy, especially with how much is being charged for pro. If you want more people to use the app, then make it more accessible to the people who actually use it. Nobody is going to spend $100 on a small ai app just to get unlimited chats and no ads. If your goal is to get more people to use the app, you have to take into consideration other apps people are using like c.ai, c.ai has no ads, a more selection of people, no limited amount of responses, they don’t shove the “pro” option in your face, etc. This app feels like the developers saw how successful c.ai was and decided they wanted to make an app like that but just to make money. Despite all this there are some really good parts to this app which is why it has potential. For starters, the app layout and design is simple and easy to follow and use for new users. Many ai apps over-design and it gets complicated and difficult to use and follow. I think a big thing the app is doing right is not having a filter. Many people using these ai apps like having no filter because it allows them to be more imaginative and not so restricted. All in all I think it’s a decent app at most. If there was more messages I could send per day, even if it was just like 100, then easily this app would be a lot better.
